script: The user’s Revolut account has been temporarily limited after a security or identity review, and the app asks them to provide a passport or other identity document. They are confused because their card no longer works and they cannot find where to upload the document, so they need guidance on opening the in-app request, taking a clear photo of the passport, submitting it securely, and understanding that Revolut will review the document before restoring full access.

The user tried to verify their address in Revolut, but their proof of address document was rejected. They uploaded a screenshot of an online bill and do not understand why it was not accepted, so they need help identifying acceptable documents, checking that the name and address match the Revolut profile, making sure the document is recent and readable, and resubmitting it through the verification flow.

The user received a request from Revolut asking for documents about the source of funds after receiving several large transfers. They worry that their account will be closed and do not know what evidence is needed, so they need an explanation that Revolut may request salary slips, tax documents, bank statements, sale contracts, or other proof depending on the origin of the money, and that the documents must clearly support the transactions under review.

The user is trying to pay in a store with their Revolut card and the payment is declined even though the account has enough money. They need help checking possible causes such as card security settings, spending limits, merchant restrictions, frozen card status, location-based security, incorrect PIN attempts, unsupported merchant category, or a temporary security decline, and they want to know what they can change in the app before retrying.

The user cannot add their Revolut card to Apple Pay because the wallet app shows an error during verification. They need troubleshooting steps around checking Apple Pay eligibility, updating the Revolut and iOS apps, confirming the card is active and not blocked, verifying the phone number used for confirmation codes, and trying to add the card again from the Revolut app rather than manually entering the details.

The user created a Revolut virtual card for an online purchase, but the merchant keeps rejecting the payment. They need help distinguishing between a standard virtual card and a single-use virtual card, checking whether online transactions are enabled, confirming that the billing address and card details are entered correctly, and understanding that some merchants or recurring subscriptions may not support certain virtual or disposable cards.

The user lost their physical Revolut card while travelling and is afraid someone may use it. They need immediate guidance to freeze the card in the Revolut app, review recent transactions, report any fraudulent payments, order a replacement card to the correct address if needed, and continue using virtual cards or mobile wallet payments where available while waiting for the new card.

The user tried to withdraw cash from an ATM, the ATM did not dispense the money, but Revolut shows the withdrawal as pending. They need reassurance that ATM transactions can remain pending while the ATM operator settles or reverses the transaction, guidance to wait for the status to update, and instructions to contact support with the ATM location, date, amount, and receipt if the transaction is completed without cash being received.

The user returned an item to a merchant and was told a refund was issued, but the money has not appeared in their Revolut balance. They need help checking the original transaction, understanding that card refunds can take time to arrive and may appear linked to the original payment, knowing when to ask the merchant for refund confirmation, and when to raise the issue with Revolut if the expected timeframe has passed.

The user disputed a card payment because the merchant never delivered the goods, but they have not received an update on the chargeback case. They need an explanation of the dispute process, that Revolut may need evidence such as receipts, tracking details, communication with the merchant, or cancellation proof, and that the timeline can depend on the card scheme and merchant response before a final outcome is available.

The user added money to Revolut with a debit card, saw the balance increase briefly, and then the top-up was reverted. They need help understanding possible causes such as the external card issuer declining or reversing the deposit, failed authentication, restrictions on the card used for deposits, or unsupported card type, and they want to know whether to retry, use a bank transfer, or contact their card issuer.

The user is waiting for an incoming bank transfer to appear in Revolut, but it is still pending or missing after the sender says the money was sent. They need help checking whether the correct local or international account details were used, whether the currency and transfer type are supported, whether intermediary banks may be involved, and what information is needed to trace the transfer if it does not arrive within the expected timeframe.

The user sent money to the wrong Revolut customer because they selected the wrong contact or Revtag. They need to know whether the transfer can be cancelled, how to contact the recipient to request the money back, how to report the issue if the recipient does not cooperate, and how to avoid the mistake in future by checking the recipient details before confirming a transfer.

The user initiated a bank transfer and Revolut asked for additional information about the transaction before processing it. They do not know why the transfer is being reviewed, so they need guidance that Revolut may ask for the purpose of payment, relationship to the recipient, invoices, contracts, or other supporting details, and that providing complete and accurate information can help the transfer review progress.

The user set up a scheduled transfer, but it failed because there were not enough funds in the Revolut account at the scheduled time. They need help understanding why the payment did not go out, how to add money and retry or create a new scheduled payment, how to edit or cancel future scheduled transfers, and how to prevent the issue by keeping enough balance in the correct currency.

The user sees a Direct Debit attempt in Revolut that they do not recognize and wants to stop it before more money is taken. They need help finding the Direct Debit mandate in the app, checking the merchant name and payment history, cancelling the mandate if needed, and understanding what to do if the payment has already been taken or if they believe the mandate was set up fraudulently.

The user’s Revolut balance became negative after several delayed card payments posted days after they were made abroad. They need an explanation that some merchants process offline or delayed payments after the original purchase, which can reduce the balance later, and they need guidance on reviewing the transactions, adding money to cover the negative balance, and contacting support if a payment looks incorrect.

The user changed their phone number and cannot log in to Revolut because verification codes still go to the old number. They need help with the recovery flow for logging in with a new phone number, confirming their identity, updating account contact details, and understanding that support may ask for additional verification if they no longer have access to the old SIM or device.

The user stored their Revolut passkey on a device that was lost or factory reset, and now they cannot authenticate on a new phone. They need help recovering account access, removing or replacing the unavailable passkey where possible, verifying identity through Revolut’s login recovery steps, and securing the account if the lost device may still be accessible to someone else.

The user is trying to sign up or log in, but the mobile verification code from Revolut never arrives. They need troubleshooting around checking the phone number format and country code, ensuring the SIM can receive SMS or calls, disabling call or message blocking, waiting before requesting another code, and using in-app support or recovery options if the code still does not arrive.

The user’s Revolut account appears restricted: card payments fail, transfers are blocked, and the app says their information is under review. They need a clear explanation that restrictions can happen during security, compliance, or information reviews, that they should check the app for requests and submit any missing details or documents, and that support may not be able to remove the restriction until the review is completed.

The user withdrew money from a Revolut Savings account, but the withdrawal is still pending and the funds are not available in their main balance. They need help understanding that Savings withdrawals may require processing depending on the savings product and timing, where to check the withdrawal status, whether weekends or holidays can affect availability, and when to contact support if the withdrawal does not complete.

The user uses a Bills Pocket to pay subscriptions and Direct Debits, but one bill failed because the Pocket did not have enough money. They need help understanding how Revolut handles bill payments from a Pocket, how to add money or adjust recurring transfers into it, how to move the bill back to the main account if needed, and how to review upcoming payments so the Pocket stays funded.

The user’s paid Revolut plan payment failed and they are worried about losing benefits or being charged downgrade fees. They need help checking the plan billing status, adding funds to pay the missed subscription amount, understanding the next payment date and plan end date, and clarifying what happens to partner benefits, insurance, or plan cards if the subscription remains unpaid or is downgraded.

The user invited a friend to Revolut and expected a referral reward, but the reward has not been credited. They need help checking the campaign requirements, whether the friend signed up using the correct invite link, added money, ordered or activated a physical card if required, made the required qualifying purchases before the deadline, and whether any exclusions or smaller reward conditions apply.

The user wants to make a Revolut travel insurance claim after delayed baggage, but they are unsure which documents are needed. They need guidance on starting the claim from the insurance section, collecting travel documents, receipts, baggage delay confirmation, airline reports, and any proof of expenses, and understanding that the insurer may request additional evidence before deciding whether the claim is covered.

The user purchased an airport lounge pass through Revolut, but the lounge staff cannot scan it or say it is not valid. They need help finding the pass in the app, checking the airport, terminal, passenger details, date, and terms of use, understanding whether the pass can be cancelled or refunded, and knowing what evidence to collect if they could not use a valid pass.

The user bought a Revolut eSIM data plan for an upcoming trip, but the eSIM will not install or activate on their phone. They need troubleshooting around checking whether the device supports eSIM, ensuring the phone is unlocked and connected to the internet, following the installation steps correctly, labeling the data plan, enabling roaming or mobile data for the eSIM, and contacting support if the plan was paid for but unusable.

The user withdrew cryptocurrency from Revolut to an external wallet, but the withdrawal is still pending and the recipient address has not received the funds. They need help checking the selected network, wallet address, withdrawal limits and fees, whether additional wallet owner information or security checks are required, how blockchain confirmations affect timing, and what to do if the transaction fails or remains pending.

The user placed a stock buy order in Revolut Trading, but the order remains pending and the shares are not visible in the portfolio. They need help understanding market hours, order types, extended-hours limitations, available cash, fractional share rules, trading halts, sell-only restrictions, and why an order may wait for execution or be cancelled depending on market conditions and the selected order instructions.
